Train Services Disrupted Due to Yard Remodeling

Train services are affected due to yard remodeling work in Bina-Agasod. The Rewa-Bina train has been canceled on October 14, and several other train services will have their routes changed. Up to 17 trains passing through Bhopal will be diverted until October 15. A special train will run on the Delhi route today.
